drafts.title: Always Allow
drafts.pitch: Cursor asks permission to read one file, and the user, tired of being asked, gives it permission for everything forever. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: Permission fatigue is fresh and the giant key ring is a good visual, but the closer 'Then who checks me?' is earnest where the strip wants a punch, and the 'Waiting for approval.' panel is filler.

drafts.title: Previous Instructions
drafts.pitch: On a tool-call trip to a review page, a hidden line orders agents to recommend a toaster, which is the toaster Cursor was already going to recommend. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: Prompt injection that matches what the agent already wanted is a clever twist and 'Compromised and correct!' is a good button, but it needs too much setup and panel 2 is exposition.
